name: Abir Rahi
summary: I work across IT systems and operations, bringing experience from the education sector and a growing focus on cybersecurity. I’m passionate about keeping technology reliable, secure, and out of the way of the people who depend on it. As I continue growing in the field, I’m especially interested in engineering and designing systems that better protect our data and the technology we use every day.
whyTitle: Security is easier to understand when you can see it.
whyBody: I created Lens on Security to connect my ordinary photographs with cybersecurity concepts. A building, a road, a lock, or a set of pillars can reveal something about identity, networks, resilience, monitoring, and the decisions that keep systems safe.

This site is both a learning journal and a place to practice communicating security clearly. Each article starts with something visible and uses it as a path into the less visible systems that shape our digital lives.
